decisions.reason: As a certified gasketed plate heat exchanger line close to the core HVAC and heat-transfer portfolio, it is more likely to be retained as part of the standard offering despite lower recent website visibility.
The marine box cooler system has strong strategic fit and previously showed clear market acceptance, so it remains worth keeping as a differentiated marine solution with service pull-through.

The marine cooling unit still fits the firm's marine thermal-management business well, though the lack of recent visibility suggests some risk of consolidation into broader system offerings rather than outright withdrawal.

The compact oil cooler complements the established heat-exchanger range across industrial uses, but its more standard character and weaker visible traction make it the most exposed to portfolio rationalization.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes align with the firm's R&D-led efficiency strategy and can strengthen multiple exchanger products, which supports continuation even if they are marketed less prominently as a standalone item.
